project.name: QuotePilot by MBMApps
project.primaryPurpose: Turn catering demand into governed quotes, customer decisions, payments, and event operations without blurring evidence boundaries.
project.economicBuyer: catering business owner or operating administrator
project.stage: deployed product with incomplete production acceptance

goals.statement: Keep pricing, tenancy, identity, and provider effects server-authoritative and fail closed.
Let an operator move one event from inquiry through quote, decision, payment, and operational handoff with explicit state.
Make release, provider, and acceptance evidence independently inspectable.
Establish repeatable buyer activation, real usage, and revenue evidence; current proof is UNVERIFIED.

evidence.note: Feature inventory and production history identify deployed pricing authority.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: Firebase Functions and tenant catalog authority

capabilities.name: Quote creation, revision, and readback
capabilities.description: Create, save, version, reopen, and export a tenant quote against an exact authoritative revision.

evidence.note: Production history records the quote system while the newest authenticated acceptance pass remains open.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: trusted quote callables and Firestore revision contracts

capabilities.name: Proposal delivery and customer decision
capabilities.description: Revision-bound proposal output, exact portal issuance, and server-owned acceptance evidence.

evidence.note: Source and prior deployment evidence exist; exact provider and recipient acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: proposal acceptance and delivery evidence callables

capabilities.name: Deposit and final-balance payment rails
capabilities.description: Separate Stripe checkout and webhook evidence for deposit and final balance.

evidence.note: Deployed rails are documented; coordinated hosted provider acceptance remains open.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: Stripe webhook callables and server payment projections

capabilities.name: Event workspace and BEO operations
capabilities.description: Role-safe event views, operational artifacts, and stale-after-revision behavior.

evidence.note: Architecture and deployed cohorts exist; hosted canonical-data acceptance remains open.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: event workspace selectors and BEO callables

capabilities.name: Operational staffing authority
capabilities.description: Tenant-scoped staffing profiles, plans, assignments, invitations, and evidence-separated acknowledgements.

evidence.note: Local focused and emulator evidence is recorded; Firebase promotion and tenant activation are pending.

capabilities.name: Ambient workspace presentation
capabilities.description: Role-safe operational presentation, exact arrivals, and bounded Pilot interaction over existing authority.

evidence.note: Exact v0.11.0 Vercel deployment is recorded; authenticated and human acceptance are not.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: React workspace routes and existing server authorities

capabilities.name: Buyer onboarding and paid workspace preparation
capabilities.description: Test-mode gated buyer invoice lifecycle and exact-email workspace activation contracts.

evidence.note: Local contracts exist; safe hosted acceptance is blocked on restricted credentials and provider checks.

capabilities.name: Stripe Connect isolated control plane
capabilities.description: Source-only owner authority, receipt bridge, isolated infrastructure, and Sandbox adapter foundation.

evidence.note: The isolated foundation is tested but unexported, uninstantiated, and provider disabled.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: separate connect codebase and provider-disabled staging program

capabilities.name: Steward bounded decision compiler
capabilities.description: Private, policy-bounded, non-authoritative decision packet and shadow-evaluation foundation.

evidence.note: Focused source, UI, browser, and rules evidence is recorded; no provider runtime or production capability exists.

capabilities.owner_or_authority: private Steward validation and consent contracts

capabilities.name: Canonical state and evidence control plane
capabilities.description: Machine-readable lifecycle ledger, proof register, executive reconciliation, and deterministic drift check.

evidence.note: Deterministic lifecycle, reference, freshness, and next-proof validation.
Focused validator tests are required before this state may remain TESTED.

decisions.statement: Browser state never establishes pricing, tenancy, provider acceptance, settlement, or operational readiness.
Commercial changes and customer decisions bind to exact saved revisions and immutable receipts.
Ambient exact arrival uses a bounded semantic URL/history hybrid with destination focus proof.
Stripe Connect remains isolated, provider disabled, and unexported until its infrastructure and hosted evidence gates pass.
Source, local tests, CI, deployment, provider outcomes, recipient behavior, human acceptance, and commercial proof are separate claims.

integrations.name: Firebase Auth, Firestore, Functions, and Hosting
Stripe payments and isolated Connect program

risks.statement: Vercel serves v0.11.0 while Firebase Hosting and Functions remain at the last recorded v0.9.0 deployment.
risks.mitigation: Promote the exact release through the governed Firebase path before acceptance claims.

risks.statement: Large source and test coverage can be mistaken for provider, production, human, or commercial proof.
risks.mitigation: Keep evidence types explicit and fail unverified claims closed.

risks.statement: Many gated source programs increase reconciliation and adoption cost.
risks.mitigation: Fund work through one observable next proof event and retire or defer programs that do not reduce its uncertainty.

blockers.statement: Firebase CI credential rotation and exact v0.11.0 all-scope promotion are incomplete.
No current authenticated end-to-end production staff acceptance receipt exists.
Exact email and coordinated payment provider acceptance remain unverified.
Buyer access needs a dedicated restricted test key, webhook checks, Turnstile checks, and bounded hosted acceptance.
Connect lacks an approved applied staging foundation, trusted runtime binding, and hosted Sandbox proof.
Steward lacks a reviewed provider transport and consenting silent-pilot human comparison evidence.
Paid customers, recurring usage, revenue, retention, and buyer acceptance are UNVERIFIED in repository evidence.

proofEvents.title: Exact v0.11.0 authenticated quote-to-operations production journey
proofEvents.hypothesis: After exact Firebase/Vercel release alignment, one authorized operator can complete the primary quote-to-operations journey without authority or evidence gaps.
preconditions: rotate the rejected Firebase CI credential
deploy exact v0.11.0 to Firebase all scope
activate only approved tenant 250 staffing after deployment receipt
proofEvents.observableEvent: One authorized tenant-250 operator creates and saves an exact quote revision, reopens it, issues the current proposal, records a customer decision, and generates the revision-bound BEO while role and cross-tenant denials remain intact.
acceptanceCriteria: exact release SHA and Firebase deployment receipt
cross-tenant and invalid portal paths fail closed
provider and recipient outcomes remain separately labeled when absent

commercialEvidence.claim: The economic buyer and buying trigger are validated.
commercialEvidence.note: The repository names likely users and workflows, not completed buyer research or purchase evidence.
No billing or customer ledger is present in repository evidence.
No revenue receipt or reconciled metric is present.

commercialEvidence.claim: Operators repeatedly complete the primary journey in production.
commercialEvidence.note: No production usage or retention evidence is present.

commercialEvidence.claim: QuotePilot measurably improves conversion, speed, margin, or operational quality.
commercialEvidence.note: No before-and-after customer outcome evidence is present.

nextActions.action: Complete the single next proof event after separately authorized credential rotation, deployment, and tenant activation.
nextActions.owner: release owner and authorized tenant operator

nextActions.action: Capture provider acceptance only through exact provider receipts; do not infer delivery or recipient behavior.
Collect buyer, paid-customer, usage, revenue, retention, and outcome evidence or leave each claim UNVERIFIED.
